💡 The novelty lies in defect-to-phase transduction: controlled oxidation converts spent olivine into Li3Fe2(PO4)3 and Fe2O3 intermediates, erasing inherited defect topology, then lithiation/reduction rebuilds LiFePO4, cutting Fe-on-Li occupancy from 5.72% to 0.35% via guanidine-assisted carbon-interface reconstruction.
